cases.description:
The walrus operator was only introduced in Python 3.8 (see [PEP 572](https://peps.python.org/pep-0572/)).

Since this library supports Python 3.7 as well, this line should be changed to:

```suggestion
    while True:
        data = await reader.read(1000)
        if not data:
            break
```
